what: Now supports Wi-Fi! Play straight to Ableton Note on your phone, with Ableton Link and Bluetooth MIDI too. Long dark screaming ambient from the frozen Arctic. A living feedback loop creeps out of the cold and grows into a howl, ice sings when struck, wind drifts over the tundra. Four tracks, ten sound sources, endless reverb and shimmer. Let it play whole pieces by itself through the eight Sami seasons.
author: PolarPatch
